top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 87, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At Love Tiles Douro Granfondo, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Train it until it feels boring.
Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 87 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 87 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 87 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 87 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.heat: April in Peso da Régua, Douro Valley, Portugal can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Love Tiles Douro Granfondo’s 87 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 87 miles of mixed terrain in Peso da Régua, Douro Valley, Portugal.
